context.healthy_metrics_and_strengths_not_to_bre: 99.4% on-time payroll accuracy, modern Euro-6 fleet (<2.5 years average vehicle age), and 91% annual retention among tenured (>2 years) long-haul C-CQC drivers.
context.cohort_and_site_asymmetries: HQ commercial/admin roles (140 staff in Verona) hire smoothly in 24 days via LinkedIn. The acute bottleneck is exclusively on the 120 frontline C-CQC driver and warehouse operator openings across the regional hubs—especially Bologna and Naples—where average Time-to-Hire has reached 43 days.
context.budget_and_capacity_constraints: Because of the 43-day Time-to-Hire, Operations is burning €190k/quarter on emergency temporary staffing agencies. The 3-person central HR team wastes over 110 hours/year manually copying hub reviews into Excel and lacks a unified ROI dashboard for the Board.
context.leadership_perceptions_and_requests: The Marketing Director proposes launching a B2B technical LinkedIn blog series to attract drivers, while Regional Hub Directors demand deploying a new mobile fast-apply widget and rewriting job ads tomorrow morning before running any portal UX or driver persona audits.
